overview.description: The ProShares S&P 500 Autocallable Income ETF (ACSP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund provides easy access to a complex strategy. The ETF uses swaps to provide exposure to a laddered autocallable strategy ACSP was launched on Aug 13, 2026 and is issued by ProShares.
